report.summary: Critical layout calculation error causing elements to overlap and broken UI rendering.
report.severity_reason: The UI is non-functional due to overlapping elements and a red error message explicitly stating 'CRITICAL UI BUG' and 'Current layout broken'.

visual_evidence.observation: Red error overlay stating 'ERROR: Layout Calculation Failed' and 'CRITICAL UI BUG: CSS_OVERFLOW_ERROR. Elements (Payment Options, Address Form) are overlapping by -250px.'
visual_evidence.location: Center of the main content area

visual_evidence.observation: Overlapping text elements in the 'Order Summary' section, such as 'TOTAL TXXtPARY' appearing garbled.
visual_evidence.location: Middle of the page, under Order Summary

visual_evidence.observation: Browser console showing multiple 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null' and 'net::ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED' errors.
visual_evidence.location: Right side of the screen in the DevTools panel

visual_evidence.observation: Redundant text entries like 'Shipping Details' appearing multiple times.
visual_evidence.location: Left side of the Order Summary section

possible_causes.why: The error message explicitly mentions a CSS_OVERFLOW_ERROR causing elements to overlap.
The console shows several TypeErrors which could prevent layout scripts from executing correctly.
The console shows 'ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED', suggesting critical CSS or JS files might not have loaded.

investigate: Inspect CSS styles related to the 'Payment Options' and 'Address Form' components to check for negative margins or incorrect absolute positioning.
Check the network tab to see which resources are failing to load (ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED).
Debug the specific JavaScript line causing the 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null' in the console.
Verify the layout calculations for the viewport width (noting the error mentions w: 1280 while the actual screenshot is 1024).
uncertainties: The error message mentions a viewport width of 1280, but the provided screenshot is 1024px wide; it is unclear if the error is specific to a certain resolution or if the error message itself is inaccurate.
It is unclear if the 'ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED' is related to the layout issue or an external network problem.
